title: 「Only when ...」倒裝句

omissions: Every numbered Important Rule and Benefit is retained as a separate Chinese-primary card. Where the PDF has no complete English counterpart, the English explanation is a faithful editorial translation.
The source filename is numbered 219; it is assigned system ID ss220 because the source set contains two distinct PDFs labelled 201.

formula: Only when + condition/time clause + auxiliary or modal + subject + main verb

formulas.formula: Only when + subject + present verb + do / does + subject + base verb
Only when + subject + past verb + did + subject + base verb
Only when + clause + modal verb + subject + base verb
Only when + clause + be + subject + complement

example: Only when people feel safe do they speak honestly.
exampleZh: 只有當人們感到安全時，他們才會坦誠發言。

examples.en: Only when people feel safe do they speak honestly.
examples.zh: 只有當人們感到安全時，他們才會坦誠發言。
examples.highlight: Only when people feel safe do they speak honestly.

meaning.zh: 這個句型突出 Only when 後面的必要條件，表示只有條件達成或時刻來到後，主句的事情才會發生。

rules.zh: 只倒裝主句 Only when 後面的子句保持正常語序。 正確： Only when people feel safe do they speak honestly. 錯誤： Only when do people feel safe, they speak honestly. people feel safe 是 when 子句，因此不需要倒裝。 需要倒裝的是主句： they speak honestly → do they speak honestly
rules.en: Invert only the main clause. Keep normal statement order in the clause after Only when: “Only when people feel safe do they speak honestly.”

rules.zh: 放在句首時，主句才需要倒裝 Only when 放在句尾： People speak honestly only when they feel safe. 這裏不需要倒裝。 Only when 放在句首： Only when people feel safe do they speak honestly. 這裏必須倒裝。
rules.en: The main clause requires inversion only when Only when is placed at the beginning. No inversion is needed when the Only when phrase comes at the end.

rules.zh: 和 did 後面使用原形動詞 does Mia smile did Ben realise do the students understand 不要寫： does Mia smiles did Ben realised do the students understood
rules.en: Use the base form after do, does and did: does Mia smile, did Ben realise and do the students understand.

rules.zh: 選擇正確的助動詞 I、you、we、they 或複數主詞 使用 do： Only when we practise regularly do we improve. He、she、it 或單數主詞 使用 does： Only when Jack feels tired does he rest. 過去發生的事情 使用 did： Only when Jack felt tired did he rest.
rules.en: Choose the auxiliary to match the subject and tense: do with I/you/we/they and plural subjects, does with a third-person singular subject, and did for the past.

rules.zh: 有情態動詞時，不要加入 do、does 或 did 正確： Only when the rain stops can we leave. 錯誤： Only when the rain stops do we can leave. 每個倒裝主句只需要使用原本的情態動詞。
rules.en: When the main clause already contains a modal verb, move that modal before the subject and do not add do, does or did.

rules.zh: 表示必要條件 這個句型並不只是表示兩件事情在同一時間發生。 它表示： 第一項條件必須達成，第二件事情才會發生。 普通時間關係： When the teacher arrived, the students sat down. （老師到達時，學生坐下來。） 必要條件： Only when the teacher arrived did the students sit down. （只有當老師到達時，學生才坐下來。） 第二句表示學生在老師到達前並沒有坐下。
rules.en: Only when expresses a necessary condition, not merely two events happening at the same time. The condition must be met before the main event can occur.

rules.zh: 開首子句後面通常使用逗號 Only when the shop opens, can customers enter. 在正式標準書寫中，更自然的標點是： Only when the shop opens can customers enter. 當開首的 when 子句較長時，可加入逗號以幫助閱讀： Only when every member of the team has checked the final plan, can the manager approve it. 不過，現代英語中也常省略這個逗號。這份練習會採用較流暢的無逗號形式。
rules.en: A comma is usually omitted after a short opening Only when clause in modern standard English. A comma may help readability after a particularly long opening clause; this exercise uses the smoother form without a comma.

benefits.zh: 清楚表達「只有達成這個條件才可以」 這個句型能讓讀者立即明白，一件事情不會隨便發生，而是必須先達成某項條件。 Only when the light turns green can drivers move. 這句清楚表示，司機必須等到綠燈亮起才可以前進。
benefits.en: It clearly expresses that something can happen only after a necessary condition has been met.

benefits.zh: 突出最重要的條件 比較： We can begin only when everyone is ready. Only when everyone is ready can we begin. 第二句把 everyone is ready 放在最前面，讓讀者先注意「所有人都準備好」這項條件。
benefits.en: It highlights the most important condition by placing that condition first.

benefits.zh: 幫助表達事情發生的先後次序 這個句型很適合說明： ● 先發生甚麼； ● 然後另一件事情才發生。 Only when I read the final email did I understand the problem. 讀者可以清楚看出，我是先閱讀最後一封電郵，之後才明白問題。
benefits.en: It helps show the sequence between an earlier condition and the event that follows.

benefits.zh: 適合用於規則、警告和指示 你可以使用這個句型清楚說明某件事情在甚麼情況下才可以進行。 Only when the machine has stopped should you open the cover. 這比只寫一個普通時間句更能突出安全條件。
benefits.en: It is useful for rules, warnings and instructions because it foregrounds the condition for safe or permitted action.

benefits.zh: 讓作文和報告的句子更有變化 學生經常以主詞開始句子： People speak honestly only when they feel safe. Students can improve only when they practise regularly. 使用 Only when 後，可以改變句子開首： Only when people feel safe do they speak honestly. Only when students practise regularly can they improve. 這能避免連續多句都使用相同的主詞開首。
benefits.en: It gives essays and reports more sentence variety by avoiding repeated subject-first openings.

benefits.zh: 讓重要觀點更有力量 在討論、演講、作文和報告中，這個句型可以用來強調真正需要改變的事情。 Only when everyone follows the rule will the system work properly. 這句把「每個人都遵守規則」表示為系統正常運作的必要條件，因此語氣較有力。
benefits.en: It gives important arguments more force by presenting a condition as essential to the result.
